laws.explanation: revertBatch zeroes committedBatches and challenges only; batchBlobVersionedHashes, batchDataStore and committedStateRoots stay.
The residual blob hash makes commitBatch revert with 'commitBatch requires no stored blob hash'; commitState is the designed recommit path.
setPause(true) deletes the challenge but keeps the +proofWindow added to every other unfinalized batch's finalizeTimestamp; the batch can then be re-challenged and the extension repeats.
_challengerWin sets revertReqIndex; nonReqRevert blocks every non-owner state transition; only revertBatch (onlyOwner) clears it.

proveState is onlyActiveSubmitter; commits revert on proveRemainingTime underflow; challengeState is blocked by inChallenge. Only the submitter (self-slashing) or the owner can close a timed-out challenge.
getFirstUnfinalizedMessageEnqueueTime reads pendingQueueIndex, advanced only by finalizeBatch. A delay until permissionless finalization, not a freeze.
